html:
Greetings, Agents! 


This is CM Fragment of the MARVEL Future Fight Team.
 
A new Mutant leader has appeared! Mutants VS Sentinels!
The battle between these two powers is unfolding in MARVEL Future Fight!
Now, I’m sure that you’re curious for more details about this House of X update, so without further ado... let’s begin!
 
Both sides have bolstered themselves to prepare for this upcoming clash!
Professor X, Mystique, and Mister Sinister have arrived! That’s 3 new characters!
Plus, Wolverine, Sentinel, Magneto, and Jean Grey have received new Uniforms!
 
Experience the power of the new Mutants by unlocking 3 new Hero’s potentials, strengthening Mystique’s Awakened Skill, and helping Professor X reach Tier-3!
 
Team up with countless Heroes and advance to higher leagues in Squad Battle!
The guide, tutorial, and S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy Missions have been updated!
In addition, various errors have been resolved in Products, the Support Shop, and more!

 
▣ 3 New Characters
 
The psychic Mutant leader Professor X, Mystique, who specializes in shapeshifting and espionage, and the mad geneticist Mister Sinister have joined the fray!
 
Experience their battle prowess for yourself!  

 

 

 

* New Character Skills are based on Level 1 stats.
* An event package for Tier-2 Mystique will be announced in a later notice and be available for purchase for a limited time.
* The Faction Battle to obtain Mister Sinister will be held for a limited time after the update, further details will be announced in a separate notice.
 
▣ 4 New Uniforms
 
Each of these characters have become more powerful thanks to their new Uniforms in preparation for the battle between the mutants and the sentinels!
Here are the details about the new looks and abilities of Magneto, Wolverine, Jean Grey, and Sentinel.
  

* New Uniform Skills are based on Level 1 stats.
* The 4 new Uniforms will be on sale during the event and will be available for purchase in the MARVEL Universe and Uniform Room after the event.
 
 
 
▣  3 Characters can now Realize their Potential! Plus, a new Tier- 3 Character!
 
Professor X, Mystique, and Mister Sinister have had their Potentials unlocked and will be able to reach level 70 after the March Update.

 

 

Not only will Professor X be able to reach level 70, but this powerful telepath and trusted leader of the mutants will also be able to awaken new abilities through a Tier-3 upgrade!
 

  

▣  A New Awakened Skill and Potential Awakening Material!
 
Mystique has received a new Awakened Skill!
Complete the Potential Awakening Skill requirements to unlock Mystique’s 6th Active Skill!
 
[Mystique Potential Awakening Requirements]

 

 


 
If you’re wondering how to awaken a character’s potential, look no further! Check out the guide below!
[Go to the Potential Awakening Guide]
 
Take note that the material source for Potential Awakening has been changed and new items have been added.
 
1. The location of Awakening Crystals has been changed from World Boss Ultimate to Squad Battle.
- Receive Awakening Crystals for clearing rounds in Squad Battle!
 
2. A new Potential Awakening material called Mandalay Gem Fragment has been added.
- Potential Awakening materials will be awarded for your Squad Battle Rank, as League Rewards, as Round Clear Rewards, and through Squad Battle Reward Chests!
 
3. The Potential Awakening materials have been changed.
▶ [Original] Cosmic Cube Fragment, Titan’s Component Pack, Dimension Dust, and Awakening Crystal
▶ [Updated] Awakening Crystal, Cosmic Cube Fragment, Mandalay Gem Fragment
 
▣ The New Squad Battle!
 
The new Squad Battle is a game mode that will give you an opportunity to use all of your characters that you’ve worked so hard to strengthen!
Take advantage of your roster of Characters you've worked so hard to grow to challenge Squad Battle now!
 
[What is Squad Battle?]
Compete with other Agents in your league for the top battle points earned by your squad!
Each squad is made of characters who meet the participation requirements.
 
Squad Battle is made of a total of 6 leagues, where you are promoted or demoted depending on your league ranking.
  

- All Agents will begin with the lowest “No League” rating, whether you join at the start of the first season or after a season has begun.
 
Form a Squad that complies with the conditions to begin battling.

 

- Only Characters who meet the conditions can join your Squad, and the Character who earned the highest score in the Squad cannot be used again in another Squad.
- Other Characters can continue on to join other Squads!
- The Squad conditions are different in each League.
 

Play freely with manual battle or sit back and watch while using Auto Play!
 

- One Squad Battle consists of 3 rounds. You can unlock the next round by achieving the target battle points before the time runs out!
 
Strategize to make the most of you Hero Bonus and Round Bonus and boost your score!
 
Bonus types:

▶ Hero Bonus: Earn bonus points for including Tier-3 characters or characters with awakened skills in your Squad!

▶ Round Bonus: A bonus dependant on your final round.

 

 

You can earn rewards based on your League Rank, Battle Score, and Rank.
▶ Round Clear Rewards: The Round Clear Rewards can only be earned once by each Squad during each season.

 

 

 

▶ Rank Rewards: This reward will be given to the top 3 ranked Agents in each League, and will be sent after the Season ends.
▶ League Rewards: Different rewards will be given based on which League an Agent is in at the end of each Season. This reward will also be sent after the Season ends.
- Everyone in the League will receive the same reward.

 

 

- A League Reward will not be issued if the Agent did not play a Squad Battle during the Season.
- The ranking of each League is determined by the total battle score of each Squad.
- The Agents who are Rank 1, 2, and 3 will receive all of the League Rewards.
 
▣ S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy Mission Improvements
 
The Academy offers constant support to our Agents through the infinite Missions!
Complete the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy missions to earn rewards.
 
1. Some missions have been improved to allow them to be replaced by other missions.
-You can only replace a mission once a day. If it is impossible to replace, a pop-up window will appear.
 
2. You’ll receive bonus points if you clear all of the missions without replacing them.
 
3. The Hero Growth Missions have been updated to exclude Store Heroes, Deluxe Heroes, Daily Biometrics/X-Gene Heroes, and Character Pack Heroes.
 
4. Some changes have been made to the UI to make it easier to view Help.
 
▣ Tutorial Renewal
 
The presentation and content of the Tutorial has now been improved!
 
1. Selecting a Code Name has been removed from the tutorial. Instead, new Agents will receive a Code Name Change item.

 

-  There are two ways to change your Code Name after the tutorial is complete.
1) Go to the [Menu]-[Inventory]-[Consumable Items] tab and use the paid item.
2) Go to the [Menu]-[Settings]-[Account] tab and touch the icon to change it.


 
2. Various areas of the tutorial have been improved for ease of understanding, such as moving by dragging the v-pad, tapping a skill to use it, and changing your Hero by tapping their portrait.
  

 

 

 

 
3. Agents can now experience Thor’s Tier-3 skill during a tutorial Boss battle.
 

 
4. Some tutorial battles have been improved.

 

 

 

 

▣ New Mystique Character Growth Packages
 
This product is made of 2 packages. Purchase the first to unlock the second.
The first package can be purchased only once, and the second package will remain on sale until further notice.

 

 

* Please note that this package cannot be refunded as the Hero is immediately paid upon purchase.
 
▣ Danger Room Reward Special Training Product


Professor X’s special training items have been added to support his growth!
Immediately upon purchase, you will receive a 6★ Professor X and gain access to a special Danger Room quest for 60 days.
 
Quest rewards include 1,250 Crystals and a Tier-2 Professor X upgrade!

 

* Please note that this special training product cannot be refunded as the Hero is immediately paid upon purchase.
* This product can be purchased one time. You can receive rewards through the special training quest for 60 days after purchase.
* Professor X’s Special Training product will be available until 5/16 2:59 p.m. (UTC +0) / 5/16 7:59 a.m. (PDT). 
* Components of this pack may be sold at a later date.
  

* Complete all of the special training quests to obtain the rewards listed above.

 ▣ A new Uniform Collection
 
See the cool new uniforms in the House of X collection!
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward!
 

▣ Other Game Improvements


 1.    A mileage system has been applied when using Custom Gear Chest x10 sold in the Store.
 
- If you do not get a CTP with the increased drop rate from buying Custom Gear Chest x10, you will earn a certain amount of mileage. Once you reach 100% you will be guaranteed to get a CTP with the increased drop rate the next time you purchase a Custom Gear Chest x10.
* Acquiring a C.T.P. with the increased drop rate will reset your mileage.
* The mileage system is reset when the current increased drop rate ends and another begins. 
* Purchasing a single Custom Gear Chest will not earn mileage.
* The mileage system does not apply during any increased chance events and the mileage system will neither increase nor reset during those events.

 

 

2. The sales prices of the Dimension Chest: ISO-8 Chest x1 and x10 have been adjusted, and 6★ ISO-8 - 6★ Awakened ISO-8 can now be acquired.

 

 

3. Some areas of the game have been improved to begin a tutorial upon first entry.
- You can check out the tutorials again through the guide menu!

 

4. An improvement has been made so that the total damage per hit is reflected in the score even if it exceeds a certain value in Alliance Battle Ultimate.

 

5. An outline has been added to the Danger Room boss to prevent them from being blocked by skill effects.

 

6. Tapping a Character model on the Battle Preparation screen in Dimensional Mission will now take you directly to the Hero Management screen.

 

7. Some Support Store tutorials have been updated.

* You will now receive 10 Groot Biometrics free during the tutorial on how to use the Store.

* The VIP benefit message is displayed on the corresponding tutorial items since the VIP discount applies to the entire Store.  Everyone will receive the 10 free Biometrics regardless of VIP status.

 

8. The camera view in the Timeline Battle Stage Map has been updated.

 

9. Biometrics for the A-Force heroes “She-hulk,” “Singularity,” and “Sister Grim” have been added in some regular selectors, dimension boxes, and Biometrics selectors.

 

10. The Thor and Black Panther bosses that appear in Story 8-1 have had their Uniforms changed.

 

11. Potential Enhance Ticket and Type Enhance Ticket buttons have been added.

* These tickets cannot be used on native Tier-2 Characters.

* The Type Enhance Ticket has not yet been released, and a detailed notice on how to get Potential Enhance Tickets will be published later.
 
▣ Other Fixes
 
1. After receiving the Danger Room Proficiency reward, there is now an immediate refresh after moving back to the waiting lobby. The lag has been removed.
 
2. The lag when moving to the Assemble Chest screen and tapping the Available Items button has been fixed.
 
3. The issue that caused the Inventory of some Agents to display as empty has been fixed.
 
4. The incorrectly displayed text in the Alliance Battle Schedule when the game was set to certain languages has been updated.
 
5. In the Legendary Battle, Infinity War - Battle of Wakanda, shields are no longer incorrectly applied during the airstrike phase. 
 
6. Store - Item now shows up correctly when searching for it after checking the item in the materials tab. The display error has been fixed.
 
7. The issue where the display would forcefully scroll to the top of the Inbox when collecting items has been resolved.
 
8. The point consumption is no longer fixed when buying Energy more than 2 times with Assemble Points.
 
9. All Colossus <Phoenix Five> Uniform Effects are now displayed correctly in the Alliance Tournament during replay.
* The Uniform effects were applied normally, the error was only in the incorrect display.

10. Some words have been removed from the banned list.
 
11. The issue where points were not obtained in the Danger Room if there was a large difference in score has been resolved.
 

12. An issue has been fixed where the energy consumption was not displayed properly in the auto-repeat popup if a Daily boost was purchased.

 

13. An issue where the debuff icon disappears later when the same debuff type is applied to the World Boss has been fixed.


This March is for the Mutants!
We hope you enjoy the new content and the upcoming events!
The next Update will be here before you know it, with even more Characters and improvements!
 
Thank you.
